title: ID0477546-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T9 4002921973] Charging session stopped
description:
Reported behavior/issue- customer reported that the charging session yesterday stopped
without charging the EV to 100% SOC.
Solution: We could check the reason for the charge session end but the same situation didn't occur on the next sessions

additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
After check the information you shared with us the session ended after the contactor shows this log.
Since it didn't show as an active flag on the charger it is working at the moment, and for this we will keep monitoring the charger for 3 days in case we have this situation happeining again.
Please let us know if you have any other charge session ended, so we can check the reason and send the technician to do a site check.
With best regards
,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
